description: Dialogs that overlay the page and demand a focused decision or task. Built on Bootstrap's modal structure (modal > modal-dialog > modal-content > header/body/footer). This theme restyles the chrome (rounded modal-content via radius-lg, soft box-shadow, white bg, generous 24px header/body/footer padding, 16px/700 title) and adds: a theme-specific modal-md size, an extra modal-xxl size (1400px), right/left slide-out panels (modal-slide-out + direction), and danger/warning header treatments (alert-modal / warning-modal). NOTE: a separate native-<dialog> 'fluid dialog' system (.dialog-fluid / .dialog-main / .dialog-content) also ships in this theme but is a distinct component, not a Bootstrap modal.

always: The dialog shell must be `<div class="modal"> > <div class="modal-dialog"> > <div class="modal-content">`.
Place a size class (modal-sm/md/lg/xl/xxl) on the `modal-dialog` element.
Give the `modal-title` an id and point `aria-labelledby` on the `modal` (or modal-dialog) at it.
Footer actions use button classes from the Button catalog (btn btn-primary for the confirm, btn btn-secondary-text or btn-outline-primary for cancel).
never: Do not invent size classes beyond modal-sm/md/lg/xl/xxl.
Do not combine a slide-out (modal-slide-out) with a centered modal-dialog-centered — the slide-out variant already extends centering and overrides margins.
For a cautionary header treatment add `alert-modal` (danger header) or `warning-modal` (warning header) directly on the modal element — never both on the same modal.
Do not confuse the Bootstrap modal classes with the native-<dialog> .dialog-* fluid-dialog system; they are not interchangeable.

a11y: Set role="dialog" (or use the native dialog semantics) and aria-modal="true" on the modal element.
Set aria-labelledby on the modal pointing at the id of the modal-title.
If there is descriptive body text, set aria-describedby pointing at the body content id.
On open, move focus into the dialog (first focusable control or the close button); trap focus within the dialog while it is open.
On close, return focus to the element that triggered the modal.
The dismiss control needs an accessible name (btn-close carries one via aria-label="Close").

size.description: Width of the modal-dialog. Placed on the modal-dialog element. modal-md and modal-xxl are theme additions; modal-sm/lg/xl are Bootstrap classes the theme also restyles.

position.description: Vertical placement / scroll behavior of the dialog.

centered.note: Vertically centers the dialog in the viewport.

scrollable.note: Constrains height and scrolls the modal-body instead of the page.

fluid.description: Edge-anchored slide-out panel. Add modal-slide-out on the modal element, then add the direction modifier modal-slide-out-right OR modal-slide-out-left (defined as chained selectors), plus the Bootstrap .slide class for the transition.

slideOut.note: Full-height edge panel. Pair with the literal direction modifier `modal-slide-out-right` or `modal-slide-out-left` (and `slide`) on the same modal element.

root.note: role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby=<title id>. Bootstrap toggles display via .show / fade.

children.note: Positioning shell. Add the size class (modal-sm/md/lg/xl/xxl) and optionally modal-dialog-centered / modal-dialog-scrollable here.
Holds the title and dismiss control.
16px / 700. Needs an id referenced by aria-labelledby.
Bootstrap dismiss button; carries data-bs-dismiss="modal" and aria-label="Close".
Right-aligned action buttons. Add bottom-buttons-footer to left-align/compact the buttons.
